reserveReview.rationale: Spark documents the V2 vault as an ERC-4626 USDC product whose permissioned Spark Liquidity Layer taker can deploy liquidity into strategies. The dated rows measure idle USDC and aggregate assets outstanding; they do not resolve the deployed position's current constituent stablecoins, venues or custody shares. Spark separately describes full USDS backing and a junior/senior capital and token-backstop loss waterfall. That economic USDS relationship is recorded as a manual serial mechanism claim, without converting the deployed accounting remainder into measured USDS custody.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Historical Ethereum ERC-4626 idle-USDC and assetsOutstanding claim accounting; selected observations only, not a reconciled whole-token backing denominator
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The historical 96.742127158783% deployed accounting position has unresolved constituent asset, venue and custodian weights. These rows measure Ethereum vault claim accounting, not a reconciled deployment-wide backing mix. The reviewed full USDS mechanism claim establishes residual loss dependence after backstops, not measured strategy allocations. Ruling D24 does not admit the system-wide Sky/Spark backing denominator as spUSDC-specific backing.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Aggregate assets outstanding to Spark Liquidity Layer strategies do not establish current constituent weights or liability reconciliation. The separate USDS mechanism claim does not resolve this basket or prove direct USDS custody.

providers.name: Spark Liquidity Layer and downstream strategies

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The vault source permits SLL to take liquidity into yield strategies. Pinned Ethereum block 26095794 and Avalanche block 96511142 on 2026-10-01 expose idle local-USDC balances and aggregate assetsOutstanding(), so the vault-versus-deployed accounting split is observable. These reads do not identify current downstream asset, venue or custodian weights, legal segregation, or insolvency treatment for the deployed positions.
